subject: Late and moving now
text: The train into your town is cancelled after a signal fault, so I'll be late. I'm trying a bus from the side stop, but it may add an hour. If you're waiting outside, move to the shelter near the bakery. I'll call when I see it. Could you also bring the spare keys, just in case my ride changes again? Please text if you leave early, because I won't see you on the platform. I'm standing with my bags at the temporary gate, and the crowd shifts. If no bus comes, I may get dropped by a taxi and arrive late.
